title: Going from Place to Place
editorial: We used pre-booked taxis for the entire trip: Colombo to Sigiriya, Sigiriya to Ella, Ella to Mirissa and Mirissa back to Colombo. Less Taxi was the service we used and can vouch for.

Buses are cheaper ways to get around, but we preferred the flexibility of having our own vehicle. We also don’t recommend driving yourself unless you’re comfortable with winding roads up- and down-hill.
If operational, the Kandy to Ella train ride is a popular choice that takes a more scenic route that cars can traverse.
